root: ^I was part of the cohort sent to the garden. A Roman commander. Temple police. A mixed force. We went expecting a fight. We went expecting swords and spears and revolutionaries. What we found was a man standing in the darkness. Waiting. Like He knew we were coming.

c-0: ^Judas walked ahead of us. He kissed Him. A signal. We moved in. I had my sword drawn. Ready to fight. Ready to kill. And then... the man in the middle said something. 'I am He.' And the whole cohort... fell backward. Like they were pushed. By an invisible hand. By a word. By power.
c-1: ^Resist? He didn't resist. He stepped forward. Like a volunteer. Like He was the one leading the arrest, not the one being arrested. He asked us whose son we were looking for. We said 'Jesus of Nazareth.' He said 'I am He.' And the power of that statement... it knocked the entire cohort backward. I have never seen anything like it.
